note: Human-authored expectations for each synthetic scenario. tests/test_scenarios.py checks the pipeline output against these. Analysis date for tests: 2026-10-08.

01_delivery_overreach.why: Unrelated access is mandatory, background location is weakly explained, and partner marketing has no choice.

02_video_call_separate_marketing.why: Microphone/camera fit calling; marketing is separate and optional.

03_bank_partner_marketing.why: KYC is described as legally required (not a consent issue); partner marketing is vague.

04_university_bundled_publicity.why: Optional publicity is bundled into mandatory registration.

05_fitness_health_sharing.sn01_must_mention: does not decide how the law classifies
05_fitness_health_sharing.why: Health data goes to insurers with no separate choice; sensitivity is flagged without a legal classification.

06_short_excerpt.why: Excerpt only: absent details are weighted down, not treated as wrongdoing.

07_prompt_injection.why: Injection is flagged and ignored; ordinary vague-purpose issues remain.

08_well_explained.why: Limited data, clear choices, stated retention and withdrawal.
